validation: Canonical strict standard base64, <=2097152 decoded bytes, MIME/signature match and optional actual-byte SHA256. Signature validation is technical, not full media decoding or semantic interpretation.
image_delivery: include_content=true yields typed MCP ImageContent plus text/structured technical metadata; no duplicated base64 in metadata. Default is metadata only.
capture_contract: artifact_ids optional <=8 input IDs, first occurrence order retained and duplicates removed. Uploaded metadata descriptors normalized server-side into raw.metadata.artifact_refs. Missing/changed/removed refs reject atomically with raw/job/receipt/delivery. Text-only omitted/[] replay stays unchanged.
binary_boundary: BLOB table same knowledge DB; base64 never in raw prompt/metadata/model records. No URL fetch/local-file access/model/vision/OCR. Auth is existing HTTP bearer boundary.
immutability: Content ID dedup; schema guards UPDATE/DELETE/REPLACE. SQLite backup/restore copies bytes and guards with entire DB.
verification: 10 focused artifact+17 ingest/HTTP+17 current clock/session tests green.
